title: Chapter 208 The Most Gentle Thing Is The Bow Of The Head
content:
Chapter 208 The Most Gentle Thing Is The Bow Of The Head

The moment Black Dragon City was breached, the scene ended.

Wang Shuo immediately took out the production drawings of the Dead Spirit Orb.

He found that the production process above was not very complicated, but he needed to learn to draw a formation.

With the foundation of drawing defensive runes before, Wang Shuo could barely understand the structure of the formation.

Wang Shuo took a simple look and put it away.

As for the battering ram drawings and arrow tower drawings, they were even better things, which made Wang Shuo quite like them.

Wang Shuo gave the energy crystal and soul crystal on the ground to Ye Xueer, which was regarded as the spoils she distributed this time.

These drawings were too important to Wang Shuo, so he did not plan to share them with others.

"Search carefully and don't leave any corner behind." Wang Shuo ordered his soldiers.

Gong Zheng and Ayub immediately took action.

One was to search for the traces of Yinghua Guzi, and the other was to see if there was anything valuable in this laboratory.

After a while, Ayub found 100 units of dark wood in a storage room next to the laboratory, which seemed to be used for experiments.

Wang Shuo was delighted. In this way, he could make dead spirit beads in the future.

And hundreds of finished dead spirit beads were also found.

Apart from that, there was nothing else of value.

A laboratory, with only these things?

Wang Shuo could only attribute the reason to Lord Zach.

After taking a last look at the laboratory, Wang Shuo walked to Ye Xueer.

"Let's go, we'll get out first!" Wang Shuo helped Ye Xueer up and walked out of the underground laboratory.

Ayub followed Wang Shuo with half of the soldiers, and the remaining half followed Gong Zheng and did not leave.

Ye Xueer, who walked into the passage, vaguely heard Locke's screams.

Back on the ground, Wang Shuo felt a little regretful that Yinghua Guzi had escaped.

When they came to the altar, everyone began to rest.

"Everyone rest on the spot, take out dry food, and replenish your physical strength." Wang Shuo said to the soldiers.

The soldiers who had meditated here before had little dead energy left on their bodies.

Wang Shuo guessed that this altar should also have drawn a dead spirit gathering array, so it could absorb dead energy.

Wang Shuo distributed the dead spirit beads to all the soldiers, so that they would not have to be afraid of dead energy for the time being.

Wang Shuo handed Ye Xueer a dead spirit bead.

The two found a clean stone and sat down.

Then, Wang Shuo took out some food and gave some to Ye Xueer.

Seeing Wang Shuo eating jerky, Ye Xueer also put down her guard and ate a few bites.

Wang Shuo glanced carefully and saw Ye Xueer eating her jerky, and smiled, but quickly restrained it.

The two ate in silence, and the atmosphere was very peaceful.

There were gusts of cold wind around, and a faint dead energy drifted towards the altar behind them.

In the sky, it was gloomy and dark, as if a storm was brewing.

But Wang Shuo didn't pay attention to these.

At this moment, his heart was beating like a deer, wanting to say something, but he didn't know what to say.

After a long time, he felt a little embarrassed.

Wang Shuo was a little dry in the mouth.

He took out a bottle of fruit wine, took a sip, mustered up the courage, looked at Ye Xueer and asked: "What's your name?"

Wang Shuo regretted it after asking. They have been fighting monsters together for so long, and they have already checked each other's information. How could they not know each other's name?

"My name is Ye Xueer, what about you?"

A pleasant and pleasant voice came to Wang Shuo's ears, like the sound of nature!

The two of them glanced at each other slightly, and found that the other was looking at them. Their faces flushed, and they quickly turned their heads and counted the ants that might be on the ground.
